TaskDescription: Ratings of partners in the Ultimatum Game task.
Instructions: Use the button box to rate each partner. Before the task, rate partner fairness and likeability; after the task, also rate anger and satisfaction with offers from each partner.

AcquisitionLabels.pre: Ratings acquired before the associated task
AcquisitionLabels.post: Ratings acquired after the associated task

AcquisitionSelectionRule: When ratings were acquired more than once for the same participant, task, and pre/post timepoint, the final complete attempt is the version of record.

trial_number.Description: Presentation order within the retained rating attempt.

Levels.dissimilar: Human partner described as dissimilar to the participant
Levels.similar: Human partner described as similar to the participant

rating_dimension.Description: Attribute or outcome evaluated for the partner.
